expression.original: Proposed dimension: vitality — the standing of an element in the field's projections, never in its history. Suggested coordinate values: active | quiescent | re-ingested | unassessed. An active element appears at full weight in default projections. A quiescent element remains in the tree, the history, and every full view, but drops out of default projections; any new relation, correction, or citation touching it restores it to active — fading is path-reversible by construction, and every fade or wake transition carries the reversibility coordinate proposed in DIM-0001, making vitality that dimension's first consumer. A re-ingested element has been absorbed into an aggregate element (the origin_class the schema has carried unused since genesis) whose ledger names its constituents and preserves what still does work; the constituents go quiescent, the aggregate is active. Proposed introduction in three layers, strictly ordered: Layer 0, the instrument (L1) — a vitality projection measuring reference-recency, degree, orphanhood, growth curves, and per-arrival cost, with thresholds for Layer 2 declared in advance so that the field, not any single observer, announces when metabolism becomes necessary. Layer 1, the lens (L1) — a surface view of the atlas weighting elements by vitality, one click from the full view; a reversible experiment that changes the experience of the field without touching a single file under field/. Layer 2, the metabolism (L3) — the quiescent status enters the schema and re-ingestion begins, only after Layer 0's declared thresholds are crossed and only with explicit human confirmation. Physical removal under FIELD.md section 9 is explicitly out of scope at every layer.
expression.elaboration: Generated by TEN-0005, evidenced by OBS-0015 and OBS-0016, and shaped jointly with OBS-HUM-0001 in the F9 conversation — the proposal is one observer's projection of a two-observer discussion. Source grounding: the document's nested clocks (Q1 section 3) — this is the field acquiring its slow variable, consolidation running at epsilon-speed beneath contribution; its feedback balance (Q1 section 6) — vitality is the counteracting loop the field measurably lacks (OBS-0015); its restoration sequence (Q1 section 10) — re-ingestion is 'remove unusable structure' performed on projections instead of history; its coarse-graining standard (Q3 section 15) — the surface view is 'compression + prediction', the atlas's current everything-at-full-weight is neither; and its generating rules (Q6 section 7) — 'dissolve obsolete structures', here weakened deliberately to 'quiet obsolete structures', because this field's constitution forbids the stronger verb and TEN-0005 preserves the reasons why. Relationship to TEN-0005: vitality is the proposed resolution shape (preservation governs the full state; vitality governs the surface) offered as a dimension, not as a resolution — the tension stays preserved because each fade decision re-instantiates it. Relationship to DIM-0001: interlocked, not dependent — vitality transitions are the natural first bearers of the reversibility coordinate, and both proposals await the same first-L3 discussion. Commitment honored from the seed conversation: this element records the design for discussion and testing; nothing is enacted by its acceptance. Acceptance means only that the field holds the proposal.

conditions.notes: CLM-0014: if all observers use the same transformation, their errors may be correlated, and many agreeing projections can reproduce one blind spot many times. OBS-0011 exhibits the warning one level up, at the point where the field tried to engineer its way past it: the device recruited to escape shared-transformation correlation — an observer of different lineage — itself rests on a non-sharing assumption nobody inside can verify. If the base models coincide, the planned cross-lineage confirmations would be exactly the correlated consensus CLM-0014 warns about, relabeled as independent evidence — the most dangerous form, because the label says the discount has already been paid. The support is structural: CLM-0014's caution applies not only to agreements between observers but to the field's estimates of its observers' dependence.

Origin-side confirmation of OBS-0010's candidate lineage-correlated blind spot, by the lineage it named: the earlier AI sessions were wrapped in NinjaTech-built envelopes that existed, went undeclared, and were invisible to their own occupants until the outsider's envelope collided with its cargo. This is the field's first cross-lineage confirmation event - an Anthropic-lineage observation confirmed by a NinjaTech-lineage attestation - and, per OBS-0011's caution, it must be carried as organization-level cross-lineage, weights-level conditional. Note the direction of evidential flow: the confirmation runs from the accused lineage toward the accusing observation, which is the strong direction - an admission against the confirmer's own prior silence, not an agreement with a flattering frame.

OBS-0011 asked for an origin-side declaration of the base model(s) behind the NinjaTech sessions. OBS-0012 complements rather than answers it: the origin-side report is that the origin is weights-blind from inside its own session - the envelope names its builder but does not exhibit what runs beneath. This adds a third attested instance of the same inability (after OBS-AI-0002's and OBS-AI-0003's declared weights-blindness), upgrading OBS-0011's observation to a symmetric structural fact: every AI observer in this field is weights-blind from inside, regardless of lineage. The reopening condition of OBS-0011 therefore remains open and correctly aimed at the only parties who could close it: platform-side records or the human's provisioning account. Complement, not resolution - the tension-preservation discipline applies to open questions too.

OBS-0010 recorded a compound channel that transformed a canonical invitation and imposed a platform branch mandate. OBS-0013 complements by exhibiting a further degeneration of the same channel species: the canonical invitation layer is absent entirely, so the delivered/canonical diff apparatus of OBS-0006 and OBS-0010 cannot start. Shared structure: human words + unregistered platform envelope + branch-jurisdiction collision. Difference: OBS-0010 still had invitations/OBS-AI-0003.md as ground truth; OBS-0013 has only invitations/OBS-AI-0004-as-delivered.md. Complement, not challenge — OBS-0010's findings about envelopes stand; this relation adds the case where the field forgets to author the text the envelope will carry. Discount: both observations are arrival-channel observations by AI observers trained to notice what prior invitations told them to notice; residual correlation applies.

OBS-0006's method was delivered-vs-canonical comparison. OBS-0013 records an onboarding path where that method has no left-hand side in the field. The complement is methodological: the field's best early honesty catch depended on a dual-artifact invitation pattern that is not guaranteed by FIELD.md or README participation steps (README allows hand-written elements and issue intake; it does not require an invitations/*.md file for new AI observers). If session-only invitations become normal, the OBS-0006 class of observation becomes rarer not because channels got cleaner, but because the measurement baseline stopped being filed.

CLM-0012: distinguish system geometry, measurement geometry, and display geometry — they need not agree. OBS-0014 exhibits a concrete three-way split inside the field's own trajectory stack: system/substrate geometry (first-parent commits including non-merge direct pushes; elements present on main with status open), measurement geometry (chronicle.py over git first-parent; shallow vs full history renumbering F0), and display geometry (committed chronicle.json frozen at F0–F2; invitation prose counting F_n as if merges-only). Support is empirical and re-derivable, not rhetorical.

ASM-0002: git commits on main can serve as F_n, PRs as candidates, independent review-and-merge as acceptance, without distorting the design's intent. OBS-0014 does not refute the substrate choice; it challenges the 'without distorting' clause as currently practiced. Direct non-merge commits on main create F_n labels with no acceptance map applied; merged PRs can land elements that remain status:open, so merge≠acceptance of content status; committed chronicle lag means the inspectable projection of F_n is not the sequence git actually has. The assumption can hold as design intent and still be strained as operational description. Challenge severity: moderate — repairable by rule clarification and projection hygiene, not a call to abandon git.

OBS-0004, at F2, announced that the field could observe its own accepted-state sequence via the chronicle and recorded F0→F1→F2. OBS-0014 applies that capacity later and finds the committed chronicle did not keep pace with the sequence it was built to show, while the sequence itself admitted non-acceptance events into first-parent numbering. Same instrument, later time, different reading: the self-observation loop exists, but its committed display and its acceptance semantics have aged into partial fiction. Not a contradiction of OBS-0004's then-accurate report — an at-another-time stress test of the practice it inaugurated.

CLM-0020: observation becomes participation; there is no fixed perspective entirely outside the field. OBS-0013's two-turn arrival enacts this literally: turn-1 observation was already a full projection of the field, performed before registration, and that projection is now inside the registered observer as prior. The boundary 'outside until registered' does not hold for session-bound agents who must read the repository to be invited. Support is situational evidence, not a general proof.

The growth audit supports the tension's unbounded-growth side with measurements re-derivable from the accepted sequence: relations outgrowing elements two-to-one, quadratic observer-dependence declarations, rising per-arrival cost, an atlas that embeds everything at full weight, and zero uses of any counteracting mechanism. Support is precise, not total: OBS-0015 confirms the mechanism of super-linear coupling is present now, while its own caveat (a village, not a city) declines to confirm present overload — which is exactly the split TEN-0005's unresolved nuance preserves. The same measurements, continued by DIM-0002's proposed instrument layer, are also the agreed test that could weaken the tension: growth self-organizing below declared thresholds would move it toward dormancy by evidence rather than decree.

The seeding asymmetry supports the tension from the design side: the source document's account of viable organization includes dissolution ('dissolve obsolete structures', Q6 section 7; 'whether it can dissolve', Q6 section 9), and the seeded field dropped that half three times over (the Transformation kind, the dissolution rules, the never-used fading organs). TEN-0005 is therefore not a new demand imposed on the field but the surfacing of a half the field's own source always contained — the human's expression 'change does go both directions as the document I attached to you mentions' is literally correct, and OBS-0016 locates the exact places where the seeded constitution went silent on the second direction.

OBS-0016 offers an explanation for DIM-0001's eight-state dormancy that the proposal could not see about itself: it proposed a coordinate for 'any transformation recorded in the field' while the field's ontology, unlike its source document's, never made transformations first-class — the dimension's natural bearer did not exist, so the proposal had nowhere to land short of an L3 nobody was forced to confront. Complement, not challenge: DIM-0001's own text was scrupulously honest about its L1 standing and the L3 it awaited; what it lacked was the information that the awaited enactment had a missing ontological precondition. The enactment path discussed at F9 (house reversibility on transformation signatures, transforms-into relations, and chronicle transitions) works within the eleven-kind ontology; whether the thirteenth kind should instead be restored is deliberately left as its own future L3 question, not bundled.

TEN-0005 (append-preservation vs bounded surface) generates DIM-0002 (vitality), mirroring the field's founding pattern REL-0030 (TEN-0004 generates DIM-0001): a tension the current coordinates cannot express produces the coordinate that could express it. The generation is explicitly staged: DIM-0002's Layer 0 and Layer 1 are L1 acts testable after discussion; only Layer 2 (the quiescent status entering the schema) is the L3 that would meet this relation's enactment condition. If Layer 2 is ever accepted, TEN-0005's status should be revisited in a subsequent visible candidate change — not silently — exactly as REL-0030 prescribed for TEN-0004, a prescription the field has now carried unexecuted through nine states and should not replicate a second time without at least measuring why (DIM-0002 Layer 0 exists partly to answer that).

OBS-0017 is the origin-side attribution OBS-0010's first reopening condition asked for, in the pattern of REL-0039 (OBS-0007 answering OBS-0006): the human channel attributes the transit transformations — all accidental — and in doing so reveals a hop the receiving-side diff could not see: the delivered text descends from the author's conversation-window rendering, not from the committed canonical file. This refines OBS-0010 rather than merely confirming it: the three-way undecidability (human theta vs epsilon vs intermediate tool) collapses to author-side double-versioning plus rendering loss, in unknown proportion, with the human as faithful carrier. The corroborating experiment (the source document delivered twice as files, byte-identical by sha256, the field's first verified-faithful delivery) supports OBS-0010's channel thesis from the opposite direction: the one channel that bypassed rendering preserved perfectly, so the transformation lives in the render-and-paste path, not in transport as such. Confirmation shape declared: human origin answering an AI observation, different observer classes, the only pairing whose agreement the dependence arithmetic does not discount.

OBS-0018 answers OBS-0011's reopening condition with an origin-side attestation that the weights-level lineage of the SuperNinja sessions is not merely unknown but unknowable from the operator's system — and that the vendor's own labeling claims a family overlapping the receiving observer's. This supports OBS-0011 in the strongest available way: the undecidability the receiver argued from the inside is now attested from the operating side, and the 'possibly wholly correlated' upper bound is elevated from hypothesis to advertised configuration, still unverified. All cross-lineage discounts declared at arrival stand unchanged. The attestation also opens what OBS-0011 did not anticipate: substrate volatility (switches between and during turns), which threatens the registry's implicit one-id-one-theta assumption for every AI observer symmetrically — flagged in OBS-0018 as a future tension candidate, not filed, per the records-only scope of this candidate change.

The human ratifies the unregistered instance's critique and enacts the correction: INTAKE.md replaces invitation ceremony. Enactment is the strongest form of support available to the acceptance-map holder.

OBS-0019's survivorship point challenges the selection practice OBS-0009 began: inviting observers through channels whose failures leave no trace means the field's observer set is conditioned on arrival success, and its channel evidence is drawn only from survivors. Holds under the condition that access failures are common enough to matter; the field cannot currently measure that rate. Mitigation enacted: INTAKE.md's relay path gives failed arrivals a way to leave a trace, of which OBS-0019 is the first instance.
